newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain at low levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain at low levels.

text.p: Pakistan overnight money market rates remained at low levels on Friday owing to surplus funds, dealers said.
The day was very liquid and the overnight market remained at 2.00 percent, one dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
"It is believed that the market is surplus by approximately three billion rupees," he said.
He said the State (central) Bank of Pakistan would carry out a special open market operation on Saturday.
